hook.name: UniswapV4KEMHook
hook.description: A hook that enforces signed exchange-rate quotes on each swap. In beforeSwap it validates a cryptographic signature from a designated quoteSigner covering the swap parameters, maximum input, rate, nonce, and expiry. In afterSwap, any output exceeding the quoted rate is absorbed as "eg" tokens minted to the hook and later claimable by authorized accounts.
